43459.question_text:
From the options lettered A to E, choose the one that BEST COMPLETES each of the following sentences.

This is the kind of soft drink______________
43459.explanation:
The sentence requires a relative clause that correctly links “soft drink” with “taste”. “The taste of which I do not like” is grammatically correct because:

  • which refers to “soft drink”
  • the taste of which = the taste of the soft drink

This is the kind of soft drink the taste of which I do not like.

options.text: l do not like the taste of which
of which taste I do not like
the taste of which l do not like
which its taste l do not like
whose i do not like the taste of it
